headline: OKC Rises, Spurs Slide
caption:
Seven days in and the NBA title race is already shifting.

OKC is the biggest riser, climbing from 25% on Oct 13 to 27% on Oct 20 and finishing the week at its peak. SA had the wildest ride: up to 22% before sliding to 17%, below its 19% start. NY also slipped from 14% to 12%, HOU edged up from 8% to 9%, and DET held steady at 6%.

Our model simulates the rest of the season and the playoffs thousands of times each day, so every game nudges these numbers. They're chances, not certainties.

Can the Spurs climb back to 22%, or is OKC pulling away?
